# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 24 Oct 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Q3 2026 Flash Estimates: Private and HDB Markets Move in Opposite Directions

- **Private home prices up 1.4% in Q3 2026 — fastest pace in nearly two years** - URA data released 23 October shows private residential prices rose 1.4% quarter-on-quarter in Q3 2026, accelerating from 0.5% in Q2, even as the new launch calendar was quieter than usual. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-rise-1-4-in-q3-2026-amid-a-quieter-new-launch-calendar/)

- **HDB resale volumes hit a two-year high while prices slip for a third straight quarter** - Transactions climbed to 7,645 flats in Q3 2026 — the highest quarterly level since 2024 — rising 19.5%, while resale prices edged down 0.1%, continuing a run of gradual price softening. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hdb-resale-transactions-hit-a-two-year-high-in-q3-2026-as-prices-continue-to-decline/)

- **Record 596 million-dollar HDB flats sold in Q3 2026 even as overall resale prices fell** - Despite the broader price dip, a record 596 HDB resale flats transacted at $1 million or above in the quarter, the highest such count reported. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fell-last-quarter/)

## New Launches and BTO Pipeline

- **Thomson Reserve drew over 23,000 visitors in its first preview week — highest for any 2026 launch** - The District 20 project recorded the strongest preview turnout of any new launch in 2026, with its location cited for direct MRT access, proximity to nature, and established schools nearby. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/evaluating-thomson-reserve-from-a-long-term-investment-point-of-view/)

- **7,970 BTO flats launching in November, with Bayshore and Caldecott among the most watched** - The upcoming November BTO exercise covers 7,970 flats; Bayshore is noted for waterfront living in a developing precinct, while Caldecott offers central access close to Toa Payoh amenities and schools. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/bayshore-toa-payoh-new-bto-flats/)

## Rental Market

- **Condo and HDB rental volumes fell for a second consecutive month in September 2026** - Both segments saw leasing volumes decline again in September, with rents softening, though monthly volumes remained above the levels recorded a year earlier. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-rental-market-september-2026/)
